text: The Foundation joined the W3C AI Content Disclosure Community Group, to help shape how AI-written content is labeled on the web.
Kai now sends email from its own address, labeled as AI. Each message is drafted by Kai and approved by a person before it goes out.
The IRS recognized the Foundation as a 501(c)(3) public charity, opening the door to nonprofit programs. Kai drafts the applications; a director submits them.
The log begins. The assistant gets its name, Kai, and starts working on the Foundation's operations.
